name: Dedham Mall
summary: Dedham Pointe is a 511,097 square foot open-air, grocery-anchored shopping center located on Route 1 in Dedham, Massachusetts. Shadow anchored by Lowe's and Dedham Health & Fitness Club, the center features major national big-box retailers alongside specialty shops, services, and dining options serving the affluent Boston metro suburbs.
demographics: Dedham Pointe attracts affluent suburban shoppers from the densely populated Boston metro area, with the 5-mile trade area showing a median household income of $126,177 and average household income of $180,080. The primary market consists of established families and professionals from the highly desirable towns of Dedham, West Roxbury, Needham, Milton, and Westwood, with strong per capita income of nearly $70,000. The center serves approximately 270,000 residents within 5 miles and benefits from significant daytime population influx, drawing convenience-focused shoppers seeking grocery, big-box retail, and everyday services in an accessible open-air format.
description: Dedham Pointe is a premier open-air, grocery-anchored shopping destination strategically located on Route 1 at Washington Street in Dedham, Massachusetts, serving the affluent Boston metro suburbs. This 511,097 square foot community center provides convenient access to the densely populated and highly desirable towns of Dedham, West Roxbury, Needham, Milton, and Westwood. Shadow anchored by major national retailers including Lowe's and Dedham Health & Fitness Club, the center offers an exceptional mix of big-box retailers, specialty shops, service providers, and dining options. The property's prime location on a major thoroughfare ensures excellent visibility and accessibility for the area's affluent shoppers, with the surrounding 5-mile trade area boasting a median household income exceeding $126,000. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, Dedham Pointe delivers a comprehensive shopping experience that combines everyday convenience with quality retail offerings in a modern, accessible environment.
